# lime-csr-js — Comprehensive LLM Reference Manual

Version: 0.6.1
Architecture: Unprivileged Micro-Kernel + Discrete Modules
Package: lime-csr-js
Platform: Browser-First Client-Side Rendering (ESM)
Security: CSP script-src 'self' Compatible (Eval-Free)

================================================================================
1. ARCHITECTURAL CONTRACT
================================================================================

Lime adheres to a strict three-tier architecture:
  Mount = Runtime Boundary
  Kernel = Generic Mechanisms (Zero domain features)
  Built-in Composition = Partial + Slot (Built-in template composition primitives)
  Modules = Domain Behavior (Conditionals, Loops, Forms, Events, Visibility)

Execution Pipeline:
1. Transform Phase (Structural Compilation):
   - Fixed-point macro expansion loop (max 100 iterations).
   - DOM mutations allowed (replaceWith, appendChild, remove).
   - Modules: partials, conditionals, loops, resolveStatic.
2. Link Phase (Behavioral Attachment):
   - Single-pass tree traversal. DOM structure is strictly frozen.
   - Zero structural mutations allowed.
   - Modules: model, text, show, events, live anchors.

Precedence vs Execution Order:
- Module Precedence: Defined by engine array order (`modules[0] > modules[1]`). Conflicting routes shadow lower-priority modules with dev diagnostic `MODULE_TRIGGER_OVERRIDDEN`.
- Execution Order: Within an element, tag triggers execute first, followed by attribute triggers in exact DOM declaration order.

================================================================================
2. COMPLETE PUBLIC API SURFACE (34 ROOT EXPORTS)
================================================================================

Subpath Exports:
  "lime-csr-js"          -> Public facade, store, diagnostics, kernel primitives, modules
  "lime-csr-js/core"     -> Kernel primitives only
  "lime-csr-js/modules"  -> 8 standard unprivileged modules
  "lime-csr-js/modules/*"-> Granular single module import (e.g. lime-csr-js/modules/text)
  "lime-csr-js/dist"     -> Minified ESM production bundle (55.0 kB)

Exact Export Inventory (35 symbols):
  Facade (3):
    mount({ target, template?, templateName?, store?, ...options }) -> Function { unmount, cleanup, target, scope, store, refs, active }
    unmount(targetOrInstance) -> void
    render(nodeOrFragment, options) -> Function { element, scope, store, refs, cleanup }

  Store & Utilities (3):
    createStore(initialState) -> Store
    getByPath(source, path) -> *
    setByPath(source, path, newValue) -> { changed: boolean, previousValue: * }

  Template & Security (7):
    getTemplate(name, document?) -> DocumentFragment
    resolveStatic(fragment, context, store?) -> void
    renderTemplate(name, context?, store?, document?) -> DocumentFragment
    escapeHtml(value) -> string
    safeAttr(value) -> string
    safeUrl(value) -> string
    safeStyleUrl(value) -> string

  Diagnostics (7):
    setDevMode(mode: boolean | 'prod' | 'dev') -> Promise
    isDevMode() -> boolean
    subscribeDiagnostics(listener: (diagnostic) => void) -> () => void
    warn(code: string, message?: string, context?: *) -> void
    reportError(code: string, details?: *, context?: *) -> void
    error -> Alias for reportError
    loadDevMessages() -> Promise

  Kernel Primitives (7):
    createEngine({ modules: ModuleDefinition[] }) -> Engine
    defineModule(definition: ModuleDefinitionOptions) -> ModuleDefinition
    attr(name: string, hooks: TriggerHooks | Function) -> TriggerDefinition
    attrs(options: AttrsOptions, hooks?: TriggerHooks | Function) -> TriggerDefinition
    tag(tagName: string, hooks: TriggerHooks | Function) -> TriggerDefinition
    pattern(prefixOrRegex: string | RegExp, hooks: TriggerHooks | Function) -> TriggerDefinition
    createScope(parentScope?: Object, localData?: Object) -> Object

  Standard Modules (8):
    partials() -> ModuleDefinition
    conditionals() -> ModuleDefinition
    loops() -> ModuleDefinition
    text() -> ModuleDefinition
    show() -> ModuleDefinition
    model() -> ModuleDefinition
    events(options?: { handlers?: Object }) -> ModuleDefinition
    ref() -> ModuleDefinition

  Distribution & CDN Files (jsdelivr / unpkg):
    dist/index.min.js: Full bundle (all 8 modules + engine + store + router) (~55.0 kB)
    dist/core.min.js: Standalone Micro-Kernel (createEngine, defineModule, triggers, scope) (~35.0 kB)
    dist/store.min.js: Standalone reactive Store (createStore) (~9.3 kB)
    dist/router.min.js: Standalone trigger router (createRouter) (~8.4 kB)
    dist/modules/index.min.js: All 8 standard modules bundled together (~32.0 kB)
    dist/modules/<name>.min.js: Discrete modules (text: ~3.8 kB, show: ~2.1 kB, events: ~6.2 kB, model: ~2.6 kB, conditionals: ~14.0 kB, loops: ~17.0 kB, partials: ~13.0 kB, ref: ~1.5 kB)

================================================================================
3. MODULE AUTHORING & CONTEXT REFERENCE
================================================================================

Module Definition Schema (`defineModule`):
```js
const myModule = defineModule({
  name: 'module-name', // Regex: /^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$/
  version: '1.0.0',    // Optional
  triggers: [          // Non-empty array of triggers
    tag('CUSTOM-ELEMENT', {
      phase: 'link',   // 'transform' | 'link'
      required: ['src'], // Declarative required attributes
      optional: ['count', 'title'], // Harvested optional attributes
      types: { count: Number }, // Type coercion (Number, Boolean, Array, Object, custom fn)
      templateDirective: 'data-custom', // Auto-routes companion <template data-custom>
      customElement: true, // Native Custom Elements bridge
      observedAttributes: ['count'], // attributeChangedCallback routes to update()
      match(el) { return true; }, // Optional predicate
      setup(el, data, ctx) {
        // data defaults to ctx.attributes if read() is omitted
        ctx.emit('ready', { count: data.count });
        return () => {};
      },
      update(el, change, ctx) {}, // Explicit update hook (receives { name, oldValue, newValue })
      cleanup(el, ctx) {},     // Explicit teardown
    }),
  ],
  beforeMount(ctx) {}, // Optional mount hook
  afterMount(ctx) {},  // Optional mount hook
});
```

ModuleContext (`ctx`) Specification:
- `ctx.scope`: Prototypally inherited lexical scope.
- `ctx.store`: Reactive Store instance (or null).
- `ctx.element`: Current DOM element.
- `ctx.trigger`: The matching TriggerDefinition.
- `ctx.moduleName`: Name of the owning module.
- `ctx.document`: Owner DOM Document.
- `ctx.window`: Owner DOM Window.
- `ctx.matchedAttribute`: String name of matched attribute.
- `ctx.attributes`: Frozen object containing harvested required and optional attributes with types applied.
- `ctx.handlers`: Handlers dictionary passed to mount/render.
- `ctx.options`: Full options object passed to mount/render.
- `ctx.refs`: Shared element references map for active mount/render runtime.
- `ctx.target`: Mount target container.
- `ctx.emit(eventName: string, detail?: *, eventInit?: CustomEventInit)`: Dispatches bubbling CustomEvent from ctx.element.
- `ctx.dispatch(eventName: string, detail?: *, eventInit?: CustomEventInit)`: Alias for ctx.emit.
- `ctx.onCleanup(fn: () => void)`: Registers cleanup callback on unified LIFO stack.
- `ctx.watch(path: string, cb: (val, prev, path) => void, opts?: { immediate?: boolean })`: Subscribes to store path. Auto-registers cleanup on unmount.
- `ctx.afterConnect(fn: () => void)`: Enqueues microtask executed after element connects to DOM.
- `ctx.update(fnOrArg)`: Safely invokes update callback with MODULE_UPDATE_FAILED error isolation.
- `ctx.transform(node, subScope?)`: Recursively runs Transform phase on subtree.
- `ctx.link(node, subScope?)`: Recursively runs Link phase on subtree.
- `ctx.error(code, details?, ctx?)`: Dispatches structured diagnostic error.
- `ctx.warn(code, message?, ctx?)`: Dispatches structured diagnostic warning.

================================================================================
4. STANDARD MODULES DETAILED SPECIFICATION
================================================================================

1. partials:
   - Tag: `<partial name="template-name" [data="scope.path"] [prop="value"]>`
   - Phase: Transform (built-in composition primitive)
   - Slots: Default (`<slot>`) and Named (`<slot name="...">`) slot projection.
     - Fallback content rendered if caller provides no matching children.
     - Projection metadata stripped: `slot` attribute removed from output DOM elements.
     - Multiple nodes targeting same slot preserve caller order.
   - Scope:
     - Partial template nodes run in isolated scope via `createIsolatedScope()`. Parent lexical scope is NOT inherited.
     - Projected slot children retain caller lexical scope (mapped via `setElementScope`). Directives/events inside slots resolve caller scope.
     - Mount-level Store is shared across both.
   - Errors: PARTIAL_MISSING_NAME, PARTIAL_NOT_FOUND, SLOT_NOT_FOUND, PARTIAL_DEPTH_LIMIT.

2. conditionals:
   - Tags: `<if>`, `<else>`, `<template data-if>`, `<template data-else>`
   - Phase: Transform (static) + Link (data-live)
   - Operators:
     `is-gt`     : Number(left) > Number(right) (uses 'than' or 'to' attribute)
     `is-lt`     : Number(left) < Number(right)
     `is-gte`    : Number(left) >= Number(right)
     `is-lte`    : Number(left) <= Number(right)
     `is-eq`     : String(left) === String(right)
     `is-neq`    : String(left) !== String(right)
     `is-truthy` : Boolean(left)
   - Anchors: `<!-- lif{n} -->` ... `<!-- /lif{n} -->`
   - Errors: MISSING_OPERATOR, UNKNOWN_OPERATOR, ELSE_AFTER_CONTENT, LIVE_IF_MISSING_OP.

3. loops:
   - Tags: `<for each="path" as="item" [index="i"] [key="item.id"] [data-live] [data-diff="simple|lcs|replace"]>`
   - Phase: Transform (static) + Link (data-live)
   - Scope: Prototypal child scope per item. Shadows parent variables natively.
   - Anchors: `<!-- lf{n} -->` ... `<!-- /lf{n} -->`
   - Diff Strategies:
     - 'simple': Key map lookup, moves mutated items.
     - 'lcs': Longest Increasing Subsequence, minimizes DOM moves, preserves focus.
     - 'replace': Rebuilds subtree from scratch.
   - Errors: FOR_MISSING_ATTR, FOR_NOT_ARRAY, FOR_MISSING_KEY, FOR_DUPLICATE_KEY, UNKNOWN_DIFF_STRATEGY.

4. text:
   - Triggers: `attr('data-text')`, `pattern(/^(?!data-).+/)`
   - Phase: Link
   - Syntax:
     `<span data-text="user.name"></span>`
     `<a href="/users/{id}" data-id="user.id"></a>`
   - Security: Uses `textContent` (no HTML entity parsing). URL attributes validated via `isSafeUrlProtocol()`. Event handler attributes (onclick, etc.) rejected.
   - Errors: BINDING_MISSING_PATH, BINDING_MISSING_DATA_ATTR, UNSAFE_EVENT_ATTR, UNSAFE_URL_ATTR, RESERVED_ATTR_NAME.

5. show:
   - Trigger: `attr('data-show')`
   - Phase: Link
   - Syntax: `<div data-show="isReady"></div>`
   - Behavior: Sets native `el.hidden = !val`. NEVER mutates inline `style.display`. Injects scoped CSS rule once: `[data-show][hidden] { display: none !important; }`.
   - Errors: SHOW_MISSING_PATH.

6. model:
   - Triggers: `pattern(/^data-model(?:[.-].+)?$/)`, `attr('data-model-group')`
   - Phase: Link
   - Control Matrix:
     - text, textarea, email, password: event 'input' (or 'change' with .lazy), reads `el.value`, writes `el.value = String(val)` (skips if equal).
     - number, range: event 'input' (or 'change' with .lazy), reads `Number(el.value)` or null, writes `el.value = String(val)`.
     - checkbox (boolean): event 'change', reads `el.checked`, writes `el.checked = Boolean(val)`.
     - checkbox (array: `name[]` or store array): event 'change', checked pushes `el.value`, unchecked removes it, writes `el.checked = val.includes(el.value)`.
     - radio: event 'change', reads `el.value` if checked, writes `el.checked = (String(val) === el.value)`.
     - select (single): event 'change', reads `el.value`, writes `el.value = String(val)`.
     - select (multiple): event 'change', reads array of selected values, writes option selection.
     - contenteditable: event 'input' (or 'blur' with .lazy), reads `el.innerHTML` (or `textContent` with .text), writes with loop guard.
   - Initial Fallback: When store value is undefined, HTML value/checked/selected/innerHTML populates the store.
   - Modifiers: `.lazy`, `.trim`, `.number`, `.debounce-<ms>`, `.text` via dot notation, dash notation, or companion attributes.
   - Group Binding: `data-model-group="prefix"` binds descendant inputs with `name="prop"` to `${prefix}.${prop}` unless explicitly overridden.
   - Dynamic group controls retain their nearest group and item/branch cleanup ownership even in detached fragments.
   - Store-backed loop aliases follow keyed reordering for writeback and subscriptions. Local lists are never mapped to same-named store lists; local-only models display their value and emit MODEL_LOCAL_PATH without writeback.
   - Errors: MODEL_MISSING_PATH, MODEL_GROUP_MISSING_PREFIX, INDEXED_MODEL_PATH.

7. events:
   - Trigger: `pattern('data-on-')`
   - Phase: Link
   - Syntax: `<button data-on-click="save">Save</button>`
    - Key Modifiers: `data-on-keydown-enter`, `data-on-keydown-escape`, `space`, `tab`, `up`, `down`, `left`, `right`, `delete`, `backspace`.
    - Behavior: Delegated on mount target. `data-on-submit` calls `event.preventDefault()`. Handler called with single payload object `{ event, element, scope, store, data, refs }`. Prototype method access blocked via `Object.hasOwn`.
    - Errors: UNKNOWN_EVENT, UNKNOWN_KEY_MODIFIER, HANDLER_NOT_FOUND.

8. ref:
   - Trigger: `attr('data-ref')`
   - Phase: Link
   - Syntax: `<input data-ref="searchBox">`, `<li data-ref="items[]">`
   - Behavior: Binds DOM element(s) to `refs` map on mount/render instance and passes `refs` to event handlers. Single elements map to `refs[name] = element`. Elements with `[]` suffix map to `refs[name] = [element]`. Duplicate names without `[]` convert to array. Automatically dereferenced on unmount.
   - Errors: REF_MISSING_NAME.

================================================================================
5. COMPLETE DIAGNOSTICS & ERROR CATALOG (47 CODES)
================================================================================

1. BATCH_FLUSH_LIMIT (Error): store.batch() flush reached 100 waves (infinite cycle).
2. BINDING_MISSING_DATA_ATTR (Warn): {x} placeholder missing matching data-x attribute.
3. BINDING_MISSING_PATH (Error): data-text attribute is empty.
4. COMPUTED_MANUAL_SET (Warn): Manual store.set() to a path managed by store.computed().
5. COMPUTED_WITHOUT_STORE (Warn): Computed options passed to mount() without a store.
6. ELSE_AFTER_CONTENT (Error): Elements found after <else> inside <if>.
7. FOR_DUPLICATE_KEY (Error): Duplicate key value found in reactive <for data-live>.
8. FOR_MISSING_ATTR (Error): <for> tag missing each or as attribute.
9. FOR_MISSING_KEY (Warn): <for data-live> missing key attribute.
10. FOR_NOT_ARRAY (Error): Loop target path is not an array.
11. HANDLER_NOT_FOUND (Error): Handler function name not defined in handlers dictionary.
12. INDEXED_MODEL_PATH (Warn): data-model contains numeric index (e.g. items.0.name).
13. IN_PLACE_MUTATION (Warn): store.set() received identical object reference.
14. LIVE_IF_MISSING_OP (Error): <if data-live> missing valid condition operator.
15. MISSING_OPERATOR (Error): <if> tag missing condition operator attribute.
16. MODEL_MISSING_PATH (Error): data-model attribute is empty.
17. MODEL_GROUP_MISSING_PREFIX (Error): data-model-group attribute is empty.
18. MODULE_AFTER_CONNECT_FAILED (Error): Exception in ctx.afterConnect() microtask.
19. MODULE_CLEANUP_FAILED (Error): Exception in module cleanup callback.
20. MODULE_HANDLER_FAILED (Error): Exception or promise rejection in user handler callback.
21. MODULE_READ_FAILED (Error): Exception in module read() hook.
22. MODULE_SETUP_FAILED (Error): Exception in module setup() hook.
23. MODULE_STORE_REQUIRED (Warn): Module ctx.watch() called without a store.
24. MODULE_TRIGGER_OVERRIDDEN (Warn): Lower-priority module trigger shadowed.
25. MODULE_UPDATE_FAILED (Error): Exception in module update() hook.
26. MODULE_WATCH_FAILED (Error): Exception in ctx.watch() subscriber callback.
27. MOUNT_ALREADY_CONNECTED (Warn): Calling mount() on an already-connected engine.
28. MOUNT_CONTAINER_UNATTACHED (Warn): Target container is detached from the active document.
29. MOUNT_INVALID_TARGET (Error): Mount target is null, undefined, or not an Element.
30. MOUNT_TARGET_NOT_FOUND (Error): CSS selector passed to mount target did not match any element.
31. MOUNT_TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND (Error): Template id/name passed to mount() does not exist.
32. MULTI_ROOT_COMPONENT (Warn): Component partial contains multiple top-level elements.
33. PARTIAL_CYCLE_DETECTED (Error): Infinite recursion detected in nested partials.
34. PARTIAL_MISSING_NAME (Error): <partial> tag missing name attribute.
35. PARTIAL_NOT_FOUND (Error): Named partial template does not exist.
36. PATH_CLOBBER (Warn): Primitive intermediate path segment clobbered by nested set.
37. REF_MISSING_NAME (Error): data-ref attribute is empty; reference name required.
38. RESERVED_ATTR_NAME (Error): Attribute template `{x}` collides with a reserved keyword.
39. SHOW_MISSING_PATH (Error): data-show attribute is empty.
40. SLOT_NOT_FOUND (Warn): <slot> element targeted by child does not exist in partial.
41. UNKNOWN_COMPARISON_OP (Error): <if> condition operator is invalid or unknown.
42. UNKNOWN_DIFF_STRATEGY (Warn): <for data-diff> specifies an unsupported reconciliation strategy.
43. UNKNOWN_EVENT (Error): Delegated event in data-on-* is unsupported.
44. UNKNOWN_KEY_MODIFIER (Error): Key modifier in data-on-keydown-* is unrecognized.
45. UNSAFE_EVENT_ATTR (Error): Attribute template used on an inline event handler attribute (e.g. onclick).
46. UNSAFE_URL_ATTR (Warn): Potentially dangerous URL protocol sanitized in href/src attribute.

================================================================================
6. COMPLETE WORKING PATTERNS
================================================================================

Pattern 1: Custom Tooltip Module with Auto-Cleanup
```js
import { defineModule, attr } from 'lime-csr-js';

export const tooltipModule = defineModule({
  name: 'tooltip',
  triggers: [
    attr('data-tooltip', {
      phase: 'link',
      read(el) {
        return { text: el.getAttribute('data-tooltip') };
      },
      setup(el, data, ctx) {
        if (!data?.text) return;
        const tip = ctx.document.createElement('div');
        tip.className = 'tooltip-bubble';
        tip.textContent = data.text;

        const onEnter = () => ctx.document.body.appendChild(tip);
        const onLeave = () => tip.remove();

        el.addEventListener('mouseenter', onEnter);
        el.addEventListener('mouseleave', onLeave);

        ctx.onCleanup(() => {
          el.removeEventListener('mouseenter', onEnter);
          el.removeEventListener('mouseleave', onLeave);
          tip.remove();
        });
      },
    }),
  ],
});
```

Pattern 2: Custom Engine Composition
```js
import { createEngine, createStore } from 'lime-csr-js';
import { text, show, events, conditionals, loops } from 'lime-csr-js/modules';
import { tooltipModule } from './tooltip.js';

const engine = createEngine({
  modules: [
    tooltipModule,
    conditionals(),
    loops(),
    text(),
    show(),
    events(),
  ],
});

const store = createStore({ items: [{ id: 1, name: 'Item 1' }] });
const instance = engine.mount({
  target: document.getElementById('app'),
  template: 'main-view',
  store,
});
```

Pattern 3: Table and Select Templates (Avoiding Foster-Parenting)
```html
<!-- Table condition and loop using template attributes -->
<table>
  <thead>
    <tr><th>ID</th><th>Name</th></tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    <template data-if is-truthy="hasItems">
      <template data-for each="items" as="item" key="item.id" data-live>
        <tr>
          <td data-text="item.id"></td>
          <td data-text="item.name"></td>
        </tr>
      </template>
      <template data-else>
        <tr><td colspan="2">No items found</td></tr>
      </template>
    </template>
  </tbody>
</table>
```
